text:
alex: Heads-up — product wants a single correlation id we can use across runtime, infra, and console dashboards. Can we agree on a format and sampling policy?

maya: +1. Current state: gateway already emits X-Request-ID for external calls, but it doesn't get propagated into gRPC metadata for internal services consistently. Also traces are sampled at 0.5% by default which makes dashboard linking flaky.

simon: For dashboards we don't need full traces for every request, but we do need deterministic correlation so logs/metrics can be joined to a trace when present. Proposals: 1) canonical header `x-redwood-request-id` (UUIDv4), propagated everywhere; 2) deterministic sampling: keep all errors/5xx, full-trace for customer-admin routes, and hash-based sampling for others (e.g. sample if hash(request_id) % 1000 == 0).

devyani: I like hash-based sampling — no central sampler and reproducible. Question: do we let SDKs generate if header absent? Some SDKs (mobile/web) already set `X-Request-ID`.

alex: Yes, SDKs should set when available. Otherwise the gateway will generate and inject `x-redwood-request-id`. We should also set `traceparent` (W3C) when we create a trace.

infra-bot: deploy status: canary rollout of gateway change (inject request id) ready for staging tomorrow @devs.

oliver: For logs/metrics we need a small set of tags: request_id, trace_id, span_id, customer_id (when available), route, model_variant, batch_size, latency_ms. That allows dashboards to pivot by customer and route.

maya: Note on privacy: customer_id might be PII for some customers; we should add a hashing/aliasing layer before emitting to observability. We already do this for traces in prod but need parity in runtime logs/metrics.

alex: Agreed. Plan sketch: 
- header: `x-redwood-request-id` (UUIDv4) always present on edge
- propagate in gRPC metadata: `x-redwood-request-id` and `traceparent`
- sampling policy: keep all errors, keep all requests for special routes (admin, billing), hash-sample 0.1% for normal traffic (configurable per-service)
- deterministic join: dashboards query logs/metrics by request_id and optionally lookup trace when sample exists

devyani: Implementation notes: runtime should attach request_id to metric labels only for a small set (route/model) to avoid label cardinality explosion. Also prefer `request_id` as a log field, not a metric label in high-cardinality metrics.

simon: We'll need a migration for dashboards: add request_id column into clickhouse table for runtime events and update existing queries to join on request_id; also change Grafana panels to attempt trace lookup when `request_id` present (link to APM).

oliver: Example query to find a trace from a request id in APM: `service:trace where tags.request_id = "{{request_id}}"` — we'll add a helper dashboard button "Open trace" that does this.

maya: Ops question: what about requests that flow through batchers where many app requests share a single runtime call? We need mapping from per-caller request_ids -> batch_span. Suggest runtime builds a parent span for the batch and includes child span ids for each input in the logs.

alex: Good call. Runtime will emit `batch_id` and `batch_span_id` alongside per-request request_id. Then dashboards can show both aggregated batch latencies and drill down to per-request records.

infra-bot: NOTE: staging rollout scheduled 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC. Follow canary steps in #eng-releases.

devyani: Security: KMS teams — if any request_id is used to fetch keys or appears in audit logs, confirm that it does not leak credentials — will coordinate offline.

oliver: UX for console: when sampling dropped (no trace), clicking "Open trace" should show a toast "trace not sampled — show logs instead" and auto-run logs query by request_id.

alex: Action items: 
- @simon: update gRPC metadata propagation lib + add deterministic sampler module (ETA 2d)
- @maya: update runtime logging shim to add request_id, batch fields, and alias customer_id (ETA 3d)
- @devyani: prepare ClickHouse schema migration and Grafana panel changes (ETA 4d)
- @oliver: design console trace lookup button + failure UI (ETA 3d)

devyani: I'll add a migration PR and a small backfill job to tag recent errors with request_id if we can reconstruct them from nginx logs. Backfill will be opt-in.

simon: One more: for local dev, add env var `REDWOOD_FORCE_REQUEST_ID=<uuid>` so we can reproduce traces end-to-end.

maya: Sounds good. I'll update the infra runbook with sampling thresholds and cardinality notes.

alex: OK — let's meet tomorrow 10am to validate PRs and rollout windows. Thanks all :thumbsup:
